scope: Prepared patch only; repository workflow unchanged; no CI, Cargo, harness, server or signal run.
rationale: Appends one separate step after the current unprivileged lifecycle step on the existing four Linux matrix jobs.
Uses the all-feature release binary already produced by scripts/check.sh; --skip-build adds no Cargo build, dependency or action.
No --mode or --signal filters means exactly ready/blocked x SIGINT/SIGTERM.
Captures the actual harness exit status despite the default shell errexit setting, prints summary.json whenever it exists, and exits with the saved status.
cat failure is ignored solely to preserve the primary harness status; no missing summary is fabricated.
The default GitHub step success condition remains; this does not run against a missing binary after an earlier build failure.
